Investment Operations professional with 4 years of experience in Fund Accounting, Hedge Funds, Trade Settlements, Corporate Actions, Reconciliation, and NAV Calculation. Hands-on experience in processing subscriptions/redemptions, cash & position reconciliations, IBoR reconciliation, benchmark data management, corporate actions, and trade settlements across global markets. Proficient in Aladdin, MS Excel, and fund accounting operations with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Analyst
Microgate Technologies March 2023 – Present
Key Responsibilities
Calculated Net Asset Value (NAV) for Private Equity, Hedge Funds, and Mutual
Funds.
Processed subscriptions, redemptions, ex-date activities, expense accruals, and
released NAVs within client deadlines.
Understood fund structures and calculated management fees, expense accruals,
capital calls, and waterfall calculations.
Performed NAV unit reconciliation between Fund Accounting and Investment
Managers.
Posted accruals, dividend adjustments, and ETD margin entries. • Resolved queries related to derivatives, FX, mark-to-market activities, corporate actions, and pre-pricing.
Calculated corporate action impacts on portfolios. • Supported new fund launches, mergers, liquidations, and redemption events. • Ensured accurate and timely trade processing into client portfolios. • Performed Transfer Agent reconciliations. • • Managed corporate action events including dividends and bonus issues. • Processed daily activities in accordance with client SLAs and operational procedures.
Investigated ledger vs sub-ledger discrepancies and posted journal entries.
Posted and validated subscription and redemption trades. • Performed custody NAV reconciliations and resolved exceptions. • Delivered accurate and timely NAVs. • Performed T+2 Cash & Position Reconciliations. • Investigated trade fails, corporate action issues, and outstanding income breaks. • Coordinated with brokers and internal teams to resolve reconciliation exceptions. • Delivered daily, weekly, and monthly NAVs accurately.
Senior Analyst
Societe Generale Global Solution Centre April 2022 – April 2023
Key Responsibilities
Managed benchmark and reference data across multiple asset classes. • Performed daily cash and position reconciliations using Aladdin. • Conducted Investment Book of Record (IBoR) reconciliations. • • Resolved discrepancies related to FX, coupons, and corporate actions. • Supported Rimes benchmark integration. • Ensured compliance with regulatory and operational requirements. Investigated and resolved complex cash breaks.
Senior Analyst
State Street HCL Services Limited November 2019 – April 2022
Key Responsibilities
Performed daily and monthly fund reconciliations. • Monitored trade settlement failures across EMEA, APAC, and Americas regions. • Reconciled positions between clients and prime brokers. • Booked interest, expenses, and wire transfers. • Processed Equities, Futures, Options, and Swaps.
Supported trade settlement and exception management activities. • Calculated mandatory and voluntary corporate actions. • Processed share entitlements and price adjustments. • Coordinated with custodians and portfolio managers to resolve corporate action issues.
